{{Quote|They broke in, hacked my system, downloaded everything, and left a virus behind that wiped out my entire mainframe. Lady Valarian was behind it. The hackers were working for her.|[[Romo Vax]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPBF" />}}
The '''Valarian hackers' bunker''' was an outpost on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] used by [[Slicer/Legends|hackers]] in the criminal organization known as the [[Valarian Syndicate]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located a short distance south of the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]], and west of [[Romo Vax]]'s [[Romo Vax's Hideout|hideout]].<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the bunker was attacked by [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna's]] henchmen because a [[Sennex]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known as Romo Vax claimed that the Valarian hackers had stolen information belonging to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="SWG:JPBF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Valarian hackers' bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Valarian hackers' bunker was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
